text:
Elena (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Samir Patel converting from contractor to full-time on Mon. Need I-9 re-verification, BG re-run, badge swap, and benefits prorate. Who's on?
Marco (Hiring): I'll meet him at 08:45. He was on contractor badge; does that need to be surrendered?
Elena (People Ops): Yes — contractor badge must be returned and replaced with an employee badge. Temp badge process applies if BG still pending.
badge-bot: Return request created: R-7721. Please drop old badge at reception and indicate "convert-to-FT".
Dan (IT): Laptop is the same device; we need to update device ownership and provision MDM profile for FT role. Can do a handshake during imaging slot 09:00 if Samir is onsite.
bg-check-bot: Candidate background re-check required for status change. Consent link sent to samir.patel@personal.email — flagged urgent.
Sophie (Payroll): For payroll we need completed I-9 and new W-4 + DD before cutoff to include him in next cycle. Benefits enrollment window: 30 days from start; we'll prorate health premiums starting his hire date.
Marco (Hiring): He asked if contractor period counts toward PTO accrual for FT start?
Elena (People Ops): Contractor time doesn't count toward PTO. PTO accrual starts on FT start date. We'll add note to offer packet and the HRIS comment.
Dan (IT): If badge swap is delayed, I can scope limited access roles so he can log into non-prod services. Prod access requires permanent badge + BG clear.
Sophie (Payroll): Also confirm citizenship docs for I-9: original passport or DL+SS card combo. If he previously used a passport as contractor, we still need to re-verify with new paperwork per policy.
Elena (People Ops): Action items: 1) Marco meet at 08:45 to collect old badge 2) Reception to take new photo & hand over FT badge once BG green 3) Dan imaging 09:00 to update MDM & ownership 4) Sophie to run payroll addition after I-9 & W-4/DD 5) BG-check bot to escalate if not completed by EOD Fri.
Marco (Hiring): Noted. I'll remind him tonight to bring original documents and to complete the BG consent ASAP.
bg-check-bot: Update: consent received. Screening started.
badge-bot: Temp badge available if needed. Permanent will be issued after BG green and I-9 on file.
Elena (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll post a short checklist to Samir and cc Marco: bring docs, return contractor badge, sign W-4+DD, attend 09:00 IT handoff. Samir — congrats and welcome aboard! :tada:
